bug_semantics: FramenetCorpusReader and NKJPCorpusReader build XML filesystem paths from caller-supplied selectors or poisoned corpus-index fields and open them with XMLCorpusView/builtin open(), bypassing CorpusReader.open() and nltk.pathsec. frame_by_name interpolates fn_fname into <root>/<frame_dir>/<name>.xml; doc() interpolates a fulltext index filename; lu/_lu_file interpolates an LU id into lu<id>.xml; NKJP add_root concatenates self.root+fileid and header/raw/words/sents read it. A ../ sequence, absolute path, or unsafe index component escapes the corpus root so those public methods parse and return outside-root XML. Affected: nltk < 3.10.0 (3.9.4 reproduced). CWE-73/CWE-22.
flaw_origin: The flawed mechanism was first written when Chuck Wooters added nltk/corpus/reader/framenet.py as 'Initial revision' on 2013-08-18: locpath = os.path.join(self._root, <subdir>, unvalidated_component) then XMLCorpusView(locpath). That first-write already covered doc (index filename), frame (index name), and lu (lu{id}.xml). 7242556 later refactored frame() into frame_by_name, feeding a caller-supplied name into the same join. NKJPCorpusReader.add_root independently introduced self.root + fileid in 2015 (abc692f). No containment existed until the 3.10.0 path-safety guards.
